instruction: Find the playoff results for the 2022 NFL season.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to playoff scores/results for 2022 season. Similar complexity to original - simple navigation to a specific season's playoff data. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match with regex to allow flexibility in URL structure (scores or results paths, POST for postseason).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to find 2022 NFL playoff results
Complete coverage: The single navigation requirement is fully verified by checking the URL pattern

Expected regex pattern is semantically correct: 'https://www\.nfl\.com/(scores|results)/2022/POST' accurately represents NFL playoff results URLs for 2022 season (POST=postseason)
Metric function 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly implements regex matching logic
